comments.author: RangerB
comments.body:
Location: Himalayan Region
When you enter the region, head to the upturned boulder in the NE. As you go past the upturned boulder go around the bend and take the left fork, I found this over the edge of the cliff on the left path as it starts to bulge before it comes together again. The discovery appears at night.

330 Adv XP for discovery
16 Adv XP for card
